40017952.author: पदार्थः
40017952.content: सः he, विभीषणःVibheeshana, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, जातहर्षः satisfied, धनुष्पाणिम् wielding bow, न him, आदाय taking, त्वरमाणःquickly, जगाम went

40017952.author: Translation
40017952.content: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Saumithri was satisfied. Wielding a bow Saumithri went quickly with Vibheeshana.

40017953.author: पदार्थः
40017953.content: विभीषणःVibheeshana, ततः thereafter, अविदूरम् little distance, गत्वा went, महत् great, वनम् forest, प्रविश्य entered, लक्ष्मणाय with Lakshmana, तत् then, कर्म What to do, दर्शयामास showed

40017953.author: Translation
40017953.content: Thereafter Vibheeshana followed Lakshmana for a small distance to the forest and showed him What to do.

40017954.author: पदार्थः
40017954.content: तेजस्वी brilliant, रावणभ्राता Ravana's brother, लक्ष्मणाय to Lakshmana, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् resembling dark clouds, भीमदर्शनम् frightening to look, न्यग्रोधम् a banyan tree, लक्ष्मणायन्यवेदयत् showed to Lakshmana

40017954.author: Translation
40017954.content: Vibheeshana, the brilliant brother of Ravana, showed Lakshmana a banyan tree resembling a dark cloud, frightening to look at.

40017955.author: पदार्थः
40017955.content: बलवान् mighty, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, इह here, भूतानाम् for all beings, उपहारम् oblations, उपहृत्य having offered, पश्चात् after that, सङ्ग्रामम् to battlefield, अभिवर्तते comes

40017955.author: Translation
40017955.content: "Mighty son of Ravana having offered oblations for all beings he comes to the battlefield. (Said Vibheeshana)"

40017956.author: पदार्थः
40017956.content: ततः thereafter, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, अदृश्यःinvisible, भवति becomes, समरे battle, शत्रून् enemies, निहन्ति kills, शरोत्तमैः best arrows, बध्नाति binds

40017956.author: Translation
40017956.content: "Thereafter he becomes invisible for all beings and kills his enemies with the best of arrows and binds them."

40017957.author: पदार्थः
40017957.content: न्यग्रोधम् banyan tree, अप्रविष्टम् entering, बलिनम् mighty, सरथम् his chariot, साश्वसारथिम् horses and charioteer, तम् them, रावणात्मजम् Indrajith, दीप्टै: flaming, शरैः arrows, विध्वंसय destroy

40017957.author: Translation
40017957.content: "Before he enters the banyan tree, you destroy Indrajith, with his chariot, horses and charioteer by the flaming arrows"

40017958.author: पदार्थः
40017958.content: महातेजाः brilliant, मित्रनन्दनः delight of friends, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, तथेति like that, उक्त्वा spoken, चित्रम् wonderful, धनुः bow, विस्फारयन् twanging, तत्र there, अवस्थितः stood, बभूव remained

40017958.author: Translation
40017958.content: Brilliant Saumithri, delighted by his friends, twanging his wonderful bow stood there, after Vibheeshana had spoken to him.

40017959.author: पदार्थः
40017959.content: बलवान् endowed with mighty prowess, रावणात्मजःIndrajith, कवची shield, खङ्गी sword, सध्वजःdecorated with post, सःइन्द्रजित् that Indrajith, अग्निवर्णेन glowing like gold, रथेन in the chariot, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared

40017959.author: Translation
40017959.content: Indrajith, who was endowed with mighty prowess, armed with shield and sword, appeared like glowing gold in the chariot decorated with a post.

40017960.author: पदार्थः
40017960.content: महातेजाः highly energetic, अपराजितम् who has never been defeated, तम् him, पौलस्त्यम् of Paulastya clan, उवाच said, ताम् to him, समरे in battle, समाह्वये challenging you, सम्यक् encounter, मे me, युद्धम् fight, प्रयच्छ directly

40017960.author: Translation
40017960.content: Lakshmana of extraordinary energy, spoke to Indrajith of the Paulastya clan," I challenge you to fight in battle directly. Fight with me."

40017961.author: पदार्थः
40017961.content: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, महातेजाः highly energetic, मनस्वी minded, रावणात्मजः Indrajith, तत्र there, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा seeing, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken

40017961.author: Translation
40017961.content: Having spoken that way, highly energetic and strong minded Indrajith seeing Vibheeshana spoke to him harshly as follows.

40017962.author: पदार्थः
40017962.content: राक्षस Rakshasa, त्वम् you, इह here, जातसम्वृद्धःborn and brought up, मम my, पितुः father, साक्षात् real, भ्राता brother, मम my, पितृव्यः father too, पुत्रस्यकथम् with son how, द्रुह्यसि hostile

40017962.author: Translation
40017962.content: "O Rakshasa! You are born here and brought up by my father. You are my father'sbrother also. How can you be hostile to your son?"

40017963.author: पदार्थः
40017963.content: दुर्मते evil minded, धर्मदूषण vitiating righteousness, तव your, ज्ञातित्वम् race, न प्रमाणम् not valuing, सौहार्दम् affection, न not, जातिः clan, न not, सौदर्यम् brotherly feeling, न not, धर्मः righteousness, न not

40017963.author: Translation
40017963.content: "Evil minded Vibheeshana! You are vitiating righteousness, have no value to your race, no affection to your clan, no brotherly feeling and have no righteousness."

40017964.author: पदार्थः
40017964.content: दुर्बुद्धे evil minded, त्वम् you, शोच्यः think, साधुभिः pitiable, निन्दनीयश्च blamed, असि also, यःत्वम् your, स्वजनम् your own people, उत्सृज्य sought, परभृत्यत्वम् enemy's protection, आगतः came

40017964.author: Translation
40017964.content: "You are evil minded, think. You are pitiable and to be blamed for you have abandoned your own people and sought the enemy's protection."

40017965.author: पदार्थः
40017965.content: स्वजनसम्वासः living with own people, क्व च is it that, नीचपराश्रयः seeking refuge from strangers, क्वच is it that, एतत् this, महत् great, अन्तरम् understanding, त्वम् you, शिथिलयता slackened, बुद्ध्या intellect, न वेसति not knowing

40017965.author: Translation
40017965.content: "You do not seem to have an understanding of the difference between living with one's own people and seeking refuge from strangers. Your intellect has slackened you are not knowing."

40017966.author: पदार्थः
40017966.content: परजनः others, गुणवान्वा virtuous, स्वजनः own people, निर्गुणोपिवा not virtuous also, निर्गुणः not virtuous, स्वजनः own people, श्रेयान् welfare, यः that which, परः others, सः he, परएवहि even if he

40017966.author: Translation
40017966.content: "Even if others are virtuous and your own people are not virtuous also one should seek the refuge of one's own people. Strangers are always strangers."

40017967.author: पदार्थः
40017967.content: यः he who, स्वपक्षम् own side, परित्यज्य renouncing, परपक्षम् others side, निषेवते seeks refuge, सःhe, स्वपक्षे own side, क्ष्यम् destruction, प्राप्ते happens, पश्चात् whose refuge was sought, तैरेव by them only, हन्यते destroyed

40017967.author: Translation
40017967.content: "He who renounces his own kind and seeks refuge from others, will be destroyed by others whose refuge he sought when his own people are destroyed."

40017968.author: पदार्थः
40017968.content: रावणानुज Ravana's brother, निशाचर night ranger, ते you, इयम् this, यादृशी way, निरनुक्रोशता ruthlessness, पौरुषम् manliness, स्वजनेन own people, त्वया by you, शक्यम् is possible

40017968.author: Translation
40017968.content: "O Ravana's brother! You have shown ruthlessness this way. O night ranger! Only you could exhibit this kind of manliness."

40017969.author: पदार्थः
40017969.content: भ्रातृपुत्रेण brother's son, इति thus, उक्तःhaving spoken, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied back, राक्षस Rakshasa, मछचीलम् my disposition, अजानन्निव as though you did not know, किम् why, विकत्थसे speak like this

40017969.author: Translation
40017969.content: Indrajith having spoken like that, Vibheeshana replied," why do you speak like that as though you do not know my disposition?"

40017970.author: पदार्थः
40017970.content: असाधो impious, राक्षसेन्द्रसुत son of Rakshasa king, गौरवात् respectfully, पारुष्यम् manliness, त्यज renounce, अहम् I, क्रूरकर्मणाम् cruel deeds, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, कुले clan, जातःयद्यपि though born, नृणाम् king, यः he who, प्रथमः primary, गुणः quality, तत् that, मे I, अराक्षसम् not Rakshasa like, शीलम् nature

40017970.author: Translation
40017970.content: "Impious son of Rakshasa king! Though born in the Rakshasa clan I renounced cruel deeds and followed respectfully manliness as my primary quality. My nature is not like that of Rakshasas."

40017971.author: पदार्थः
40017971.content: अहम् I, दारुणेन cruel, न रमे not revel, अधर्मेण च unrighteousness, न रमेवै not follow, विषमशीलोऽपि of unfavourable disposition, भ्राता a brother, भ्रात्रा by a brother, कथम् how निरस्यते expelled

40017971.author: Translation
40017971.content: "I do not delight in cruel deeds, nor follow unrighteousness. Or else because of unfavourable disposition how can a brother be expelled by a brother?"

40017972.author: पदार्थः
40017972.content: धर्मात् righteous, प्रच्युतशीलम् who has renounced, पापनिश्चयम् of sinful deeds, पुरुषम् man, हस्तात् from hand, आशीविषंयथा venomous serpent, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, सुखम् happiness, अवाप्नोति attains

40017972.author: Translation
40017972.content: "The association of one who has renounced righteousness and is of sinful deeds is left by a righteous man who undoubtedly attains happiness, is like shaking of a venomous serpent from the hand."

40017973.author: पदार्थः
40017973.content: परस्वहरणे seizing property of others, युक्तम् united, परदाराभिमर्शकम् with others wife, दुरात्मानम् evil mindedness, प्रज्वलितम् burning, वेश्मयथा like house, त्याज्यम् getting out, आहुःit is said

40017973.author: Translation
40017973.content: "Seizing the property of others, uniting with others wife, evil mindedness is said to be given up like getting out of a burning house."

40017974.author: पदार्थः
40017974.content: परस्वानाम् others wealth, हरणम् stealing, परदाराभिमर्शनम् possessing others wife, सुहृदाम् friends, अतिशङ्का च distrusting, त्रयःदोषाः three faults, क्षयावहाः will destroy

40017974.author: Translation
40017974.content: "Stealing the wealth of others, possessing others wife, distrusting friends, these three faults will destroy a person."

40017975.author: पदार्थः
40017975.content: महर्षीणाम् sages, घोरः dreadful, वधः killing, सर्वदेवैः all deities, विग्रहः च haughtiness, अभिमानश्च irascibility, रोषः च anger, वैरित्वं च animosity, प्रतिकूलता refractoriness, जीवितैश्वरनाशनाः put an end to one's life, एते all these, दोषाः faults, मम my, भ्रातुः brother's, गुणान् qualities, तोयदाः rainy clouds, पर्वतानिव mountains, प्रच्छादयामासुः put an end to future

40017975.author: Translation
40017975.content: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."

40017976.author: पदार्थः
40017976.content: महर्षीणाम् sages, घोरः dreadful, वधः killing, सर्वदेवैः all deities, विग्रहः च haughtiness, अभिमानश्च irascibility, रोषः च anger, वैरित्वं च animosity, प्रतिकूलता refractoriness, जीवितैश्वरनाशनाः put an end to one's life, एते all these, दोषाः faults, मम my, भ्रातुः brother's, गुणान् qualities, तोयदाः rainy clouds, पर्वतानिव mountains, प्रच्छादयामासुः put an end to future

40017976.author: Translation
40017976.content: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."

40017977.author: पदार्थः
40017977.content: तव your, पिता father, भ्राता brother, एतैःदोषैः these faults, मया by me, परित्यक्तःaband oned, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी Lanka city, न अस्ति not be there, त्वम् च you too, न not, ते to you, पिता च father, न not

40017977.author: Translation
40017977.content: "Because of these faults your father and my brother has been abandoned by me from this Lanka. This Lanka will not be there, nor your father and you too."

40017978.author: पदार्थः
40017978.content: राक्षस Rakshasa, अतिमानी च mean, बालश्च proud of might, दुर्विनीतश्च immoral, कालपाशेन by noose of death, बद्धः bound, त्वम् your, माम् my, यत् यत् Whatever, इच्छसि wish to say, ब्रूहि say

40017978.author: Translation
40017978.content: "O Rakshasa! You are mean, proud of might, immoral and bound by the noose of death. Whatever you wish to say you may say."

40017979.author: पदार्थः
40017979.content: राक्षसाधम lowly among Rakshasas, किं why, त्वम् your, वक्ष्यसि to you, अद्य today, इह here, व्यसनम् worry, प्राप्तम्? come, त्वया by you, न्यग्रोधम् banyan tree, प्रवेष्टुम् entering, न शक्यम् not possible

40017979.author: Translation
40017979.content: "O Lowly Rakshasa! This worry has come to you today. Entering the banyan tree is not possible for you today."

40017980.author: पदार्थः
40017980.content: काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, धर्षयित्वा clashing, त्वया by you, जीवितुम् life, न शक्यम् not possible, रणए in combat, नरदेवेन god of retribution, लक्ष्मणेनसहस with Lakshmana, युध्यस्व waging war, त्वम् you, हतः killed, यमक्षये abode of yama, देवताकार्यम् tasks of Devatas, करिष्यसि will be doing

40017980.author: Translation
40017980.content: "Clashing with Lakshmana of Kakuthsa clan is not possible for you. By waging war with Lakshmana, you will be killed and reaching the abode of the Lord of death. You will be doing tasks of deities of Devatas."
